test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Playing in the park is one of the thing that small children really love.
solution: The correct answer is option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Here,** 'One of the things'** is used instead of 'One of the thing'. • **'One of the' **takes **plural noun { ***one of the + plural noun ***}** • **​Example: ***One of the students was selected to visit ISRO.​*__ • **__*​*__**__Therefore__, as per the point mentioned above, we find that the incorrect answer is** option 3.****​** ​Hence, the correct sentence is "__**Playing in the park is one of the '*things' *that small children really love.***".*__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** __ • यहां, 'One of the things' का प्रयोग किया जाता है 'One of the thing' की जगह। • 'One of the' बहुवचन संज्ञा का प्रयोग करता है I { *one of the + plural noun *} • 'With' preposition का प्रयोग 'उपकरण', 'हथियार', को इंगित करने के लिए किया जाता है। • उदाहरण: *One of the students was selected to visit ISRO.*__ • __*​*__इसलिए, ऊपर बताए गए बिंदु के अनुसार, हमे पता लगा गलती **विकल्प 3** मे है। ​​ ​अत: सही वाक्य "__Playing in the park is one of the 'things' that small children really love".__है I 59:Tbd7, The correct answer is **option 2.**
